socialAdditional.ruleScoreSummary: Gym volume × elapsed hours ÷ body weight (kg)
socialAdditional.ruleScoreDetail: Volume is the sum of confirmed repetitions × weight in kg. Elapsed time includes pauses. Your profile weight is recorded at completion. Whole points are rounded half up. Missing or non-positive inputs earn no credit.
socialAdditional.ruleDailyCreditSummary: Your best gym workout each day
socialAdditional.ruleDailyCreditDetail: Only your highest rounded score each day counts. Start at or after joining and finish and submit before the round closes. For ties, the earliest completion wins, then the lowest workout ID. A workout can count in multiple leagues.
socialAdditional.ruleWeeklyRoundsSummary: Monday at midnight to the following Monday
socialAdditional.ruleWeeklyRoundsDetail: The workout start determines its league-local day. Each round starts Monday 00:00 inclusive and ends the next Monday 00:00 exclusive, including daylight-saving changes.
socialAdditional.ruleStandingsSummary: All rounds count toward the overall total
socialAdditional.ruleStandingsDetail: General standings include the current and all past rounds. Equal totals share a rank.
socialAdditional.ruleRoundOutcomeSummary: Lowest scores share the losing position
socialAdditional.ruleRoundOutcomeDetail: With at least two members, everyone tied for the lowest round total loses, including zero scores. Unseen results appear oldest first and are acknowledged after display.
